chapters.text_fil: Ang North Cotabato ay tinatawag na pinto ng Mindanao dahil dito ay nagtatagpo ang maraming kultura at tradisyon. Ang matabang lupa ng Cotabato Basin ay matagal nang tinitirhan ng mga Maguindanao at Manobo. Ayon sa alamat, ang lupa ng Cotabato ay pinagpalang lupa na binuhusan ng ulan ng mga diyos nang walang tigil sa loob ng tatlumpung araw upang maging napaka-masagana.
chapters.text_eng: North Cotabato is called the gateway of Mindanao because here many cultures and traditions meet. The fertile soil of the Cotabato Basin has long been inhabited by the Maguindanao and Manobo. According to legend, the land of Cotabato is blessed soil that was rained upon by the gods without ceasing for thirty days to make it extremely bountiful.
